prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” AI video ad maker — the right choice depends on your goals, budget, and desired workflow. Below are the top options (as of my last update in June 2024), grouped by use case, with quick pros/cons to help you pick.

If you want realistic AI presenters / talking-head ads
- Synthesia
  - Pros: High-quality multilingual AI avatars, easy script → video, brand kit, enterprise features and integrations.
  - Cons: Less control over cinematic visuals; costs rise for heavy use.
  - Best for: Product demos, spokesperson-style ads, localized ads with consistent on-screen host.
- HeyGen (formerly Movio / others in the space)
  - Pros: Competitive pricing, good avatar variety, fast generation.
  - Cons: Slightly less polish than Synthesia for some avatars.
  - Best for: Fast presenter ads at lower cost.

If you want fast script-to-video using stock footage & captions (for social ads)
- Pictory
  - Pros: Excellent at turning scripts/articles into short videos, auto-captioning, template library.
  - Cons: Visuals are stock-based, so less custom look.
  - Best for: High-volume social ads and repurposing blog content.
- InVideo / Promo.com / Lumen5
  - Pros: Large template libraries, ad-oriented presets and aspect ratios, simple UI.
  - Cons: Outputs can look template-y unless customized.
  - Best for: Quick social creative, marketers who need multiple ad variants.

If you need advanced editing, voice cloning, or repurposing
- Descript
  - Pros: Industry-leading transcription and overdub (voice cloning), multitrack editing, easy repurposing.
  - Cons: Not focused on AI avatars; better as an editor than pure generator.
  - Best for: Ads that need precise voice/word edits and efficient repurposing workflows.
- Opus Clip / VEED.io
  - Pros: Designed for short-form clipping and formatting for social platforms; auto-editing and captioning.
  - Best for: Creating many short ad variants and vertical/short formats.

If you want cutting-edge generative visuals or creative effects
- Runway
  - Pros: Strong generative video and image tools, advanced editing, great for creative/brand-forward ads.
  - Cons: More learning curve; may require more manual work to polish.
  - Best for: High-concept or visually unique ads where generative visuals add value.

How to choose (quick checklist)
1. Define your primary need: presenter avatar, fast social ads, repurposing, or creative visuals.
2. Budget & scale: Do you need dozens of variants or a few high-quality ads?
3. Brand requirements: custom voice, brand kit, multiple languages/localization?
4. Output & integration: ad platform formats, API access, team collaboration.
5. Test with a free trial: run the same script through 2–3 tools to compare speed, realism, and cost.

If you tell me:
- your budget,
- the ad format (talking head, product demo, 15–30s social, long-form),
- need for voices/languages/brand kit,
I’ll recommend the single best option and a backup and suggest a test plan.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
